checks.detail: Listed as Real Estate / Real Estate Investment Trusts. Some scholars allow this line of business and some do not; look at what it sells.
Interest-bearing debt: 52.5% of its market value; the screen allows under 33%.
Cash and short-term investments: 0.8% of its market value; the screen allows under 33%.

checks.test: Money owed to it, plus cash
checks.detail: Receivables plus cash: 2.7% of its market value; the screen allows under 49%.
Common screens also want under 5% of income from interest or other things not allowed, and some ask that it be given away. Free data does not show this; the study can look for it.
